annotationNote: D-02 candidate batch (28 November 2026). Each source's PMID, DOI and title were matched against its PubMed record; full text, passages and rights were not retrieved. Assertions are editorial paraphrases of the abstracts, unreviewed and not graph-promotable. Trial results are reported as candidates, never as treatment recommendations.

sources.title: Genome-wide association study of systemic sclerosis identifies CD247 as a new susceptibility locus
sources.design: genome-wide association study with independent replication
sources.limitations: European-ancestry samples only; a susceptibility locus does not identify the causal variant, cell type or mechanism.

sources.title: Five amino acids in three HLA proteins explain most of the association between MHC and seropositive rheumatoid arthritis
sources.design: MHC fine-mapping by imputation of classical alleles and amino acids
sources.limitations: Imputed variants in seropositive disease; risk association does not establish antigen-presentation mechanism in a given person.

sources.title: PTPN22 genetic variation: evidence for multiple variants associated with rheumatoid arthritis
sources.design: gene sequencing and matched case-control genotyping with replication
sources.limitations: White North American samples; R620W does not fully explain the PTPN22 association.

sources.title: Functional haplotypes of PADI4, encoding citrullinating enzyme peptidylarginine deiminase 4, are associated with rheumatoid arthritis
sources.design: case-control linkage-disequilibrium study with transcript and serology follow-up
sources.outcome: Rheumatoid arthritis susceptibility and anti-citrullinated peptide antibody levels
sources.limitations: Single-population association; replication across ancestries is not shown by this source.

sources.title: Molecular subsets in the gene expression signatures of scleroderma skin
sources.design: DNA microarray gene-expression profiling of skin biopsies
sources.outcome: Intrinsic gene-expression subsets of scleroderma skin
sources.limitations: Small cohort (17 diffuse, 7 limited SSc, 3 morphea, 6 controls); subsets need independent validation.

sources.title: Myofibroblast transcriptome indicates SFRP2^hi^ fibroblast progenitors in systemic sclerosis skin
sources.design: single-cell RNA sequencing of SSc and healthy dermal fibroblasts
sources.limitations: Lineage is inferred from transcriptomes in biopsies, not traced over time in people.

sources.title: Defining inflammatory cell states in rheumatoid arthritis joint synovial tissues by integrating single-cell transcriptomics and mass cytometry
sources.design: integrated single-cell RNA-seq, mass cytometry, bulk RNA-seq and flow cytometry of synovial tissue
sources.outcome: Cell states expanded in rheumatoid arthritis synovium
sources.limitations: 51 samples; comparison with osteoarthritis tissue; cell states are associations, not demonstrated drivers.

sources.title: Causes and risk factors for death in systemic sclerosis: a study from the EULAR Scleroderma Trials and Research (EUSTAR) database
sources.design: prospective multicentre cohort (EUSTAR) with Cox regression
sources.outcome: Causes and predictors of death in systemic sclerosis
sources.limitations: Cause of death questionnaires returned for 234 of 284 deaths; referral-centre cohort.

sources.title: Case-control study of corticosteroids and other drugs that either precipitate or protect from the development of scleroderma renal crisis
sources.limitations: Retrospective and observational; confounding by indication is possible.

sources.title: Nintedanib for Systemic Sclerosis-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease
sources.outcome: Annual rate of decline in forced vital capacity over 52 weeks
sources.limitations: Sensitivity analyses gave P values of 0.06 to 0.10; no benefit on skin score or respiratory quality of life.

sources.title: Tocilizumab in systemic sclerosis: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
sources.outcome: Change in modified Rodnan skin score at 48 weeks
sources.limitations: Primary endpoint not met; lung-function findings are secondary and nominal.

sources.title: Rituximab versus intravenous cyclophosphamide in patients with connective tissue disease-associated interstitial lung disease in the UK (RECITAL): a double-blind, double-dummy, randomised, controlled, phase 2b trial
sources.outcome: Rate of change in forced vital capacity at 24 weeks
sources.limitations: Mixed connective tissue disease population including scleroderma; superiority design.

sources.title: Mycophenolate mofetil versus oral cyclophosphamide in scleroderma-related interstitial lung disease (SLS II): a randomised controlled, double-blind, parallel group trial
sources.outcome: Change in FVC % predicted over 24 months
sources.limitations: Primary comparison negative; within-group improvements come from a post-hoc analysis.

sources.title: Safety and efficacy of abatacept in early diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis (ASSET): open-label extension of a phase 2, double-blind randomised trial
sources.design: open-label extension of a phase 2 randomised trial (ASSET)
sources.outcome: Modified Rodnan skin score at 18 months
sources.limitations: Open-label and uncontrolled after month 12; improvement was seen in both groups.

claims.subject: CD247
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: a CD247 locus (rs2056626) was associated with systemic sclerosis susceptibility in a European-ancestry genome-wide study with replication.
claims.design: genome-wide association study with independent replication
claims.population: European ancestry; 2,296 cases and 5,171 controls (discovery), 2,753 cases and 4,569 controls (replication)
claims.limitations: Association locus only; the causal variant and the affected cell type are not established.

claims.subject: IRF5
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the same study confirmed the IRF5 gene region as a systemic sclerosis genetic risk factor.
claims.design: genome-wide association study with independent replication
claims.population: European ancestry; 2,296 cases and 5,171 controls (discovery), 2,753 cases and 4,569 controls (replication)
claims.limitations: Confirms a known region; it does not show how IRF5 variation acts in disease.

claims.subject: STAT4
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the same study confirmed the STAT4 gene region as a systemic sclerosis genetic risk factor.
claims.design: genome-wide association study with independent replication
claims.population: European ancestry; 2,296 cases and 5,171 controls (discovery), 2,753 cases and 4,569 controls (replication)
claims.limitations: Confirms a known region; mechanism and cell type are not tested.

claims.subject: HLA-DRB1 amino acids 11, 71 and 74
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: three amino-acid positions in HLA-DRβ1, with single positions in HLA-B and HLA-DPβ1, almost completely explained the MHC association with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis.
claims.design: MHC fine-mapping by imputation
claims.assay: SNP imputation of classical HLA alleles and amino acids
claims.limitations: Seropositive disease only; imputed rather than directly typed alleles.

claims.subject: PTPN22
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the PTPN22 haplotype carrying the W620 allele (R620W, rs2476601) was associated with rheumatoid arthritis, and R620W did not fully explain the PTPN22 association.
claims.design: sequencing and matched case-control genotyping with replication
claims.population: White North American; 475 cases and 475 controls, then 661 cases and 1,322 controls
claims.limitations: White North American samples only.

claims.subject: PADI4
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: PADI4 was identified as a rheumatoid arthritis susceptibility locus; a susceptibility haplotype affected transcript stability and was associated with anti-citrullinated peptide antibody levels.
claims.design: case-control linkage-disequilibrium study
claims.assay: haplotype genotyping, transcript stability and serology
claims.limitations: Population not stated in this record; replication across ancestries is not shown here.

claims.subject: Intrinsic skin gene-expression subsets
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: genome-wide skin expression separated diffuse from limited SSc and defined intrinsic subsets marked by proliferation, immune-infiltrate and fibrotic programmes.
claims.design: DNA microarray profiling of skin biopsies
claims.population: 17 diffuse SSc, 7 limited SSc, 3 morphea, 6 healthy controls
claims.limitations: Small cohort; subsets need independent validation before any stratified use.

claims.subject: SFRP2-high DPP4+ dermal fibroblast progenitors
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: single-cell transcriptomes indicate that SSc dermal myofibroblasts arise in two steps from an SFRP2-high, DPP4-expressing fibroblast progenitor population.
claims.design: single-cell RNA sequencing of dermal fibroblasts
claims.limitations: Inferred from transcriptomes at one time point; not lineage-traced in people.

claims.subject: Skin myofibroblasts
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the source reports that myofibroblast numbers in SSc skin correlate with the modified Rodnan skin score.
claims.design: single-cell RNA sequencing with clinical correlation
claims.limitations: Correlation reported as background; not a causal test in this study.

claims.subject: THY1+ HLA-DRA-high sublining fibroblasts
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: THY1+ HLA-DRA-high sublining fibroblasts were expanded in rheumatoid arthritis synovium compared with osteoarthritis, and IL6 expression was attributed to them.
claims.design: integrated single-cell and bulk profiling of synovial tissue
claims.assay: scRNA-seq, mass cytometry, bulk RNA-seq, flow cytometry
claims.limitations: 51 samples; expansion is associative and compared with osteoarthritis, not healthy tissue.

claims.subject: Peripheral helper T (Tph) cells
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: PDCD1+ peripheral helper T cells and follicular helper T cells were among the cell states expanded in rheumatoid arthritis synovium.
claims.design: integrated single-cell and bulk profiling of synovial tissue
claims.limitations: Associative; a driver role is proposed, not demonstrated.

claims.subject: Pulmonary fibrosis
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: in the EUSTAR cohort, pulmonary fibrosis accounted for 35% of SSc-related deaths, ahead of pulmonary arterial hypertension and cardiac causes (26% each).
claims.design: prospective multicentre cohort
claims.limitations: Referral-centre cohort; causes come from questionnaires for 234 of 284 deaths.

claims.subject: Proteinuria
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: proteinuria was an independent predictor of mortality in SSc (hazard ratio 3.34), alongside PAH, restrictive lung function and dyspnoea.
claims.design: prospective multicentre cohort with Cox regression
claims.limitations: Predictor in an observational cohort; not a causal or treatment-response finding.

claims.subject: High-dose corticosteroids
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: prednisone of 15 mg/day or more in the prior 6 months was more frequent in patients who developed scleroderma renal crisis than in matched controls (36% vs 12%; odds ratio 4.37).
claims.design: retrospective matched case-control study
claims.population: 110 SSc patients with renal crisis and matched controls (1981–1993)
claims.limitations: Retrospective; confounding by indication cannot be excluded. Not a dosing recommendation.

claims.subject: Nintedanib
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: in SSc-associated interstitial lung disease, the annual rate of FVC decline was lower with nintedanib than placebo (−52.4 vs −93.3 ml per year).
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
claims.intervention: nintedanib 150 mg twice daily vs placebo
claims.limitations: Primary result P=0.04, but sensitivity analyses gave P=0.06–0.10. Diarrhoea in 75.7%. Not a treatment recommendation.

claims.subject: Nintedanib
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: in the same trial, change in modified Rodnan skin score at week 52 did not differ between nintedanib and placebo.
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
claims.limitations: Key secondary endpoint; the trial was not designed for skin disease.

claims.subject: Tocilizumab
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the primary skin endpoint was not met; change in modified Rodnan skin score at week 48 did not differ significantly from placebo (difference −1.73; p=0.10).
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
claims.population: 210 adults with diffuse cutaneous SSc ≤60 months
claims.limitations: Early diffuse SSc only.

claims.subject: Tocilizumab
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: a secondary analysis favoured tocilizumab on FVC % predicted at week 48 (difference 4.2; nominal p=0.0002).
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
claims.limitations: Secondary endpoint with nominal P values after a failed primary; hypothesis-generating only.

claims.subject: Rituximab
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: rituximab was not superior to intravenous cyclophosphamide for FVC change at 24 weeks in connective tissue disease-associated ILD; FVC improved in both groups.
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, double-dummy phase 2b trial
claims.population: 101 patients with severe or progressive CTD-ILD (UK)
claims.limitations: Mixed CTD population (scleroderma, myositis, mixed CTD); superiority not shown does not establish equivalence.

claims.subject: Mycophenolate mofetil
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: the course of FVC % predicted over 24 months did not differ between mycophenolate mofetil and oral cyclophosphamide; mycophenolate was better tolerated.
claims.design: randomised, double-blind, double-dummy trial
claims.intervention: mycophenolate mofetil 24 months vs oral cyclophosphamide 12 months
claims.limitations: Primary comparison negative; improvement within each arm is from a post-hoc analysis.

claims.subject: Abatacept
claims.assertion: Candidate summary: in the ASSET open-label extension, skin scores improved further in both groups once all patients received abatacept, with no new safety signals.
claims.design: open-label extension of a phase 2 randomised trial
claims.population: 64 patients with early diffuse cutaneous SSc
claims.limitations: Uncontrolled after month 12; improvement in both groups limits attribution to abatacept.

gaps.subject: CD247
gaps.question: Do SSc susceptibility loci (CD247, IRF5, STAT4) change Tfh or B-cell behaviour in people with SSc?
gaps.missing: Genotype-stratified immune phenotyping in SSc cohorts; no source in this graph links these loci to the Tfh–IL-21 axis.
gaps.nextStudy: Compare circulating Tfh frequency and IL-21 output by risk genotype in a pre-registered SSc cohort, adjusted for disease duration and treatment.

gaps.subject: Nintedanib
gaps.question: Does slowing FVC decline over 52 weeks translate into fewer SSc-ILD deaths?
gaps.missing: Long-term outcome data linking the trial FVC endpoint to survival; the trials here report 24 to 52 week lung function only.
gaps.nextStudy: Follow trial participants or a matched registry for mortality and transplant, with FVC trajectory as a pre-specified mediator.

gaps.subject: HLA-DRB1 amino acids 11, 71 and 74
gaps.question: Do HLA-DRB1 risk amino acids relate to which synovial cell states expand in rheumatoid arthritis?
gaps.missing: Synovial single-cell data stratified by HLA-DRB1 genotype; the sources here study genetics and tissue separately.
gaps.nextStudy: Profile synovial biopsies by genotype with the same single-cell panel and test a pre-specified association.
